design_frozen.table: the kernel's fixed flat 64-slot WormholeTable (content-addressed, LWW, live row-major reads), sigma = kernel default log2(3). qthe.mjs untouched; the harness passes its own instrumented read-logging wrapper via opts.table (the E-Q14 family-B instrumentation, verbatim semantics).
design_frozen.task: E-Q14 family-B twin-delivery task at matched geometry: plantTwinPairs + plantWeather + polluters, theta_del=8, T=200, seeds 77001..77010 (10 trials per scale x arm), determinism rerun x2 from fresh construction.
design_frozen.pairs: K=8 twin Abstain pairs HELD CONSTANT across all scales (AMENDED by EQ17-AM3 after the LOUD planting throw: the K=20 default and the pre-registered K=16 fallback are both weather-infeasible at 64x64; K=8 is the maximally E-Q14-matched option — see amendments). Planting is now E-Q14-VERBATIM: distinct d window [8,15] (the plantTwinPairs default), minPairSep=24, minCrossSep=8 (toroidal Chebyshev), weather 2x Attract (d=40,41) + 1x Repel (d=30) >=10 from every pair member, >=4 mutual. Feasibility verified pre-run: K=8 plants on 10/10 seeds at ALL three scales; K=12 fails on 10/10 seeds at 64x64 (the weather wall); K<=11 feasible at 64x64, K=8 chosen for exact E-Q14 calibration. No further fallback: if K=8 ever throws, the geometry itself is the finding and the experiment reports the infeasibility.

arms_per_scale.density: E-Q14-matched area density = 256 polluters per 4096 cells (E-Q14's heaviest arm, where pf saturated to 1.0): 256 @ 64x64, 1024 @ 128x128, 4096 @ 256x256. Polluter semantics verbatim E-Q14: seeded positions >= 2 toroidal-Chebyshev from every pair member, each carrying one of the pair d values (seeded assignment), so polluters write the same slots the twins use.
arms_per_scale.fixed256: 256 polluters at EVERY scale (separates polluter DENSITY from polluter COUNT; at 256x256 this is 0.39% density ~ E-Q14's 16-polluter regime).
arms_per_scale.coincidence_receipt: At 64x64 the density and fixed256 arms coincide (both = 256 polluters): the config runs ONCE and is reported under both arm labels, receipted in the results and chain rows.

metric.pf_definition: pf = pollutionFraction = pollutedEvents / pairEvents, EXACTLY E-Q14's field and computation (the code's own `pf` variable): pair-member twin events are matched to the occupant of the slot they read by sequential slot+resonance matching against the tick's live-read log (first unused read in log order, occupant != event cell); occupant == partner -> partnerEvents, everything else INCLUDING null occupant -> pollutedEvents. Same field semantics, same instrumentation, qthe.mjs untouched.
metric.pf_interpretation_receipt: The r12 registration cites 'E-Q14 sealed pfMed 0.9431 at zero polluters' as the calibration for the 'provenance floor 0.90' — 0.9431 is E-Q14's pollutionFraction median, so the floor coheres ONLY with pf = pollutionFraction (the complementary provenance fraction at 64x64 clean is 0.0569, which would make the 0.90 floor stillborn). pf is therefore sealed as E-Q14's pollutionFraction. Because the registration's FIRE band reads as a provenance-degradation trigger while pf-as-pollution inverts that reading, BOTH bands are pre-registered (below) and BOTH verdicts reported; the primary null is |Delta| and is reading-independent.
metric.provFrac_definition: provFrac = partnerEvents / pairEvents per run (the provenance-CORRECT fraction; per-run complement of pf). Reported beside pf in every aggregate so the record is interpretation-proof.
metric.median_convention: pfMed/arm-scale = median over the 10 seeds, numeric sort, UPPER middle (index floor(n/2)) — the corpus convention (e_q13/e_q14/e_q16/verdict_recompute).
metric.recovery_implementation: Bucketed-by-(slot,resonance) matching, provably order-equivalent to E-Q14's linear scan (first-unused-in-log-order with occupant != event cell); the runner ASSERTS equivalence against the verbatim E-Q14 linear recovery on every clean arm (full run) and on the first 25 ticks of every polluter arm — any divergence is a LOUD throw, not a silent speedup.

floors_frozen.EQ17_delivery: delivery floor 100% per arm: every run of every scale x arm delivers ALL 20 pairs (both members' meters >= 8 by T=200). E-Q14 sealed delivery at ceiling (80/80); if delivery ever breaks, that IS the finding, not a failure — escalation row, experiment stands.
floors_frozen.EQ17_pf_calibration: pf(64x64, clean) median >= 0.90 — reproduces E-Q14's sealed zero-pollution regime (0.9431 at K=8; the K=20 convoy is expected to compress provenance further, not less). Below 0.90 = calibration finding (the K=20 geometry diverges from E-Q14's K=8 regime), receipted as an escalation row; it does NOT void the scale-inert null, which is a within-experiment Delta.
floors_frozen.EQ17_occupancy_cap: occupiedCount() <= 64 at every checkpoint of every arm (kernel invariant; a violation is a kernel defect finding, experiment VOID).
floors_frozen.EQ17_F0_determinism: every (scale, arm, seed) runs TWICE from fresh construction — byte-identical checkpoint plane-hash sequences at ticks [0,50,100,150,200], else VOID.

primary_null_and_bands.H0_primary: provenance is scale-inert: |pfMed(256x256, clean) - pfMed(64x64, clean)| <= 0.02. Reading-independent (the complement preserves |Delta|).
primary_null_and_bands.FIRE_band_verbatim: the hierarchical trigger FIRES (H1 registered for build) if pfMed(256x256, arm) < pfMed(64x64, arm) - 0.05 on the clean OR density-matched arm — the r12 registration's band, applied verbatim to pf = pollutionFraction.
primary_null_and_bands.MIRROR_band_preregistered: pfMed(256x256, arm) > pfMed(64x64, arm) + 0.05 on the clean or density-matched arm is the SAME verbatim band under the complementary reading (pf' = provFrac = 1 - pf: pf'(256) < pf'(64) - 0.05) — i.e. provenance DEGRADES at scale, the HIERARCHICAL-WORMHOLES 'flat tables lose WHO' direction. Pre-registered here as a judgment-band escalation: measured, documented, no silent build either way; the verdict names which reading fired which band.
primary_null_and_bands.judgment_band: any |Delta| in (0.02, 0.05] on clean or density-matched arms: measured, documented, no build — the judgment call gets written down either way (the registration's own words).

dispositions.A1_critical_population_vs_density: REFUTED — the attack assumes 10% Abstain density (the E-Q16-C regime); E-Q17's twin-delivery task plants K=20 pairs HELD CONSTANT across scales, so the clean arm's Abstain population (and writes/slot) is scale-constant — which is exactly A1's own prescribed fix ('fix total Abstain cell count across scales'), already the frozen design. The density arm scales polluters with area BY DESIGN to match E-Q14's heaviest per-area arm. H0 lives on the clean arm only.
dispositions.A2_critical_fixed256_uninterpretable: REFUTED — the fixed-256 arm's variation IS the pre-registered discriminator: its polluter COUNT (hence writers per pair-slot) is scale-constant, so a scale-inert pf there contrasts with E-Q16's density-scaled contention and pins the load variable to writers-per-slot, not grid size. A2's fix (density-match every arm) would destroy the density-vs-count separation the r12 registration froze this arm to make.
dispositions.A3_major_d_window_violates_minPairSep: REFUTED — minPairSep=24 is a SPATIAL constraint (toroidal Chebyshev distance between pair members' grid positions, enforced by plantTwinPairs which throws loudly), not a d-value separation; E-Q14's own 8 pairs used ADJACENT d values (8..15, differing by 1) and the adjacent-d convoy is the sealed B3-autopsy mechanism this experiment calibrates against. The K=20 baseline shift is exactly why the calibration floor is a lower bound (>= 0.90, not == 0.9431) and the primary null is the within-experiment Delta.
dispositions.A4_major_delivery_floor_unachievable: REFUTED — delivery is CONTENT-addressed (E-Q14 sealed 80/80 pair-trials delivered at 256 polluters with pf = 1.0, and family A sealed firers ratio 1.0 at phi = 1.0): more contention means MORE firing, not less — a pair member fires whenever any non-self resonant occupant is in its slot, and the live LWW read almost always finds one once the slot is warm. E-Q16's 5874 writes/slot was the 10%-density regime (6,554 Abstain cells), not this task's 40-cell clean arm. The 100% floor stays frozen; if it breaks, that IS the finding (the registration's words); relaxing a floor post-hoc is the forbidden move.
dispositions.A5_major_bucketed_vs_linear_equivalence: ACCEPTED IN PART — AMENDMENT 1 below strengthens the equivalence law beyond the original receipt: the verbatim E-Q14 linear recovery runs on ALL 64x64 and 128x128 arms (full runs), and on 256x256 the bucketed matcher must survive a per-seed 25-tick prefix equivalence assertion PLUS a full 200-tick cross-check on seed 77001, against the verbatim linear scan, every run. Any divergence is a LOUD throw and the run is void. This executes A5's own falsifier (overlapping slot+resonance events, bucketed vs linear) continuously at scale instead of once.
dispositions.A6_minor_coincidence_duplicates_medians: ACCEPTED AS SCHEMA CLARIFICATION — AMENDMENT 2 below: results are keyed by canonical (grid, nPoll) config with an arm_labels field (at 64x64 the 256-polluter config carries [density, fixed256]); pfMed/provMed are computed strictly per (scale, arm) over that cell's 10 distinct seeds and NEVER pooled across arms or configs, so no data point is counted twice anywhere. The arm coincidence at the base scale is a shared experimental condition, receipted, not a duplicated sample.

The 256x256 runs use the bucketed-by-(slot,resonance) matcher (order-equivalent by construction) ONLY behind two live assertions, re-executed every run: (a) per-seed, ticks 1..25: bucketed output must equal the verbatim linear output event-for-event; (b) seed 77001, full T=200: same equality over the whole run. amendments.why: Measured infeasibility, not post-hoc choice: at 64x64, plantWeather's awayFromPairs=10 exclusion zones around the pair members saturate the torus as K grows — K=12 fails on 10/10 seeds (the first sampleFar/plantWeather budget exhaustion), so the pre-registered K=16 fallback and the brief's K=20 default are both geometrically impossible at the base scale with E-Q14-matched weather.
